note: ERRATA 54, and Q9 and Q14 as ruled. ONE DRAWN SIZE. Errata 24's two tiers, its decimation threshold and the eye_death_row measurement behind it are all void: errata 54 replaced decimation with ordinary filtered resampling, so there is nothing for a threshold to switch between. Frames are individual RGBA files in the per-clip directories under art/actors/, which is what the old sheet-and-cell schema could not address -- that was the blocking half of Q14. Generated by tools/build-actor-record.mjs from each directory's rig.json; do not hand-edit.
heightNote: coach is not a person: its height is its own art at the scale the room was measured for, and it is NOT a point on the depth curve.
idleBreakNote: Doc 40's idle-break, which the old record could not declare because it had no clip for it. Played on a timer while he is idle and returning to stand afterwards, never looped. 2/s over twelve frames is a six-second gesture.
